promptDrafts.foreground: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the wetland/primary-v1.png generated master. Fine reeds and rushes from a Normandy marsh bordering the bottom and left edges only, visible individual thin stems, desaturated green-gold, natural upper-left misty morning illumination. Full same-size landscape canvas, preserve lens, perspective and light. Remove every background pixel with actual alpha, no solid fill or painted checkerboard. Preserve delicate edges. No new species, devices or text. Candidate for a matching clean plate, not ready for parallax over the unmodified master.
